name: Pinatubo 1991 - climactic VEI 6
description: Scenario approximating the 15 June 1991 climactic eruption of Mount Pinatubo, the second-largest eruption of the 20th century. Sustained ~35-40 km Plinian column, extensive pyroclastic flows filling valleys to >10 km, and global ash/aerosol injection. VEI 6.
historical_note: Erupted ~10 km3 of material; pyroclastic flows travelled up to 16 km from the vent. The very low Heim coefficient reflects exceptionally mobile, voluminous PDCs.
